description: This file contains low-level cryptographic big number arithmetic functions, including multiplication, squaring, and division of large integers, implemented in C with conditional compilation for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies and adds a series of words, accumulating the result in a pointer array, using hardware-accelerated or software fallback implementations.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies a series of words by a single word, storing result in output array, with hardware-accelerated or fallback implementation.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares an array of words representing a large number, optimized for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Divides a large word composed of high and low parts by a divisor, producing the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two large multi-word numbers, with implementation optimized for 64-bit hardware or fallback algorithm.
